title: Character and String Types knowledge check

questions.prompt: What is the most direct learning goal for this lesson?
options: The main goal is to apply character and string in a small Swift example and verify the result.
Use character and string types only for visual styling.
Skip type checking and accept any result.
Replace a focused example with unrelated code.
questions.answer_key: The main goal is to apply character and string in a small Swift example and verify the result.
questions.explanation: Character and String Types is best learned through a small, verifiable example. Swift strings operate on Unicode text rather than raw bytes. Use String APIs and valid String indices; never assume one user-perceived character equals one byte.
